initialize.instructions: Flight search assistant powered by Aviasales/Travelpayouts API. Use the tools to search flight prices, find the cheapest dates, discover where to fly, and look up airline/airport/city codes. Every flight tool takes IATA codes — resolve a place name with lookup_cities or find_nearest_airports first. All price data comes from a cache of recent user searches (last 48h) and is per adult in economy.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description:
Search flight prices between two cities on a date or across a month.

Use when the user names both ends of a route and wants fares, a booking
link, or only departures inside a time window. For the cheapest day in a
month use `get_prices_calendar`; for the days around dates already chosen
use `get_flexible_date_prices`; for a budget with no destination use
`search_by_price_range`.

Both codes must be IATA — call `lookup_cities` first if you only have a city
name. For nearby airports use `get_alternative_directions`. A multi-city
trip needs one call per leg.

Note on passengers: the price data comes from a cache of recent searches and
is always PER ADULT in economy. The adults/children/infants/trip_class
parameters are encoded into each ticket's booking_link, so the link opens
Aviasales with the full party pre-filled and shows the real total price.

Durations: each ticket reports duration_total (full door-to-door travel
time), duration_to/duration_back (pure flight time per direction) and
layover_minutes (combined ground time between connecting flights; 0 for
direct flights). All values are in minutes.

departure_at.description:
Departure date or month (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Optional;
a month searches every day in it.

return_at.description: Return date or month (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Optional.

direct.description: If True, show only non-stop flights.

currency.description:
Price currency code (3 letters, e.g. "rub", "usd"). Defaults to
the server's configured currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read (e.g. "us", "ru", "th").
The same route in the same currency is priced differently per market,
so set this to the traveller's country. Defaults to the server's
configured market.

one_way.description: If True, search one-way tickets only.

children.description:
Number of children 2-11 years, 0-8 (default 0). Adults plus
children cannot exceed 9; the excess is trimmed.

infants.description:
Number of infants under 2, 0-8 (default 0). Cannot exceed the
number of adults; the excess is trimmed.

depart_after.description:
Keep only flights departing at or after this local time
("HH:MM", 24-hour). Optional.

depart_before.description:
Keep only flights departing at or before this local time
("HH:MM", 24-hour). Optional. Combined with depart_after and set
earlier than it, the window wraps midnight (e.g. 22:00-06:00).

tools.name: get_prices_calendar
tools.description:
Get grouped calendar prices for a route, one fare per day or per month.

Use when the user asks which day or month is cheapest to fly a known route.
For fares on one specific date use `search_flights`; for a few days either
side of dates already chosen use `get_flexible_date_prices`. Codes are
IATA; use `lookup_cities` to resolve a name first.

Prices are per adult (cached); passenger parameters are encoded into each
booking_link.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read (e.g. "us", "ru").
Defaults to the server's configured market.

children.description:
Number of children 2-11 years, 0-8 (default 0). Adults plus
children cannot exceed 9; the excess is trimmed.

infants.description:
Number of infants under 2, 0-8 (default 0). Cannot exceed the
number of adults; the excess is trimmed.

tools.name: get_flexible_date_prices
tools.description:
Compare prices for the days around a departure and an optional return.

Use when the user already has dates and asks whether shifting a day either
way would be cheaper. For one exact date use `search_flights`; for the
cheapest day across a whole month use `get_prices_calendar`. This covers
roughly a week around both the outbound and the return.

return_date.description: Intended return date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit for one-way.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read. Defaults to the
server's configured market.

tools.name: get_latest_prices
tools.description:
Get the most recently found flight prices from other travellers' searches.

Use when the user wants the latest fares that just appeared, on one route
or across the whole cache. For a specific trip on chosen dates use
`search_flights` instead. Prices are per adult (cached); passenger
parameters are encoded into each booking_link.

These rows come from the older v2 shape: they name the selling `agency`
rather than an airline, carry no flight number, and their booking_link is
reconstructed from the route and dates.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read. Defaults to the
server's configured market.

children.description:
Number of children 2-11 years, 0-8 (default 0). Adults plus
children cannot exceed 9; the excess is trimmed.

infants.description:
Number of infants under 2, 0-8 (default 0). Cannot exceed the
number of adults; the excess is trimmed.

tools.name: get_popular_directions
tools.description:
List the cities people most often fly to a destination from, with a fare.

Use when the user asks where travellers reach a city from and what that
costs. The request is keyed on the destination. For where someone can fly
from a city use `get_city_directions`; for prices on one known route use
`search_flights`.

destination.description:
Destination IATA code (e.g. "BKK"). Required — the API
rejects a request without it.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

locale.description: 2-letter locale for city names. Defaults to the server's locale.

tools.name: get_city_directions
tools.description:
List the cheapest destinations reachable from a city, with a fare and dates.

Use when the user asks where they can fly from a city, or wants somewhere
cheap without naming a destination. For who flies into a city use
`get_popular_directions`; to price one chosen route afterwards use
`search_flights` or `get_prices_calendar`.

origin.description:
Origin city IATA code (e.g. "MOW"). Use `lookup_cities` to
resolve a city name first.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

tools.name: get_alternative_directions
tools.description:
Get prices for nearby airports and cities around a chosen route.

Use when the traveller can fly from or into a different airport and wants
those fares. To learn which airports are near a place, use
`find_nearest_airports` first; for the named city pair only, use
`search_flights`.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read. Defaults to the
server's configured market.

tools.name: search_by_price_range
tools.description:
Find flights whose cached fare falls inside a minimum and maximum price.

Use when the user has a budget, including anywhere under a price with no
destination named. Leave `destination` unset to let the budget pick the
city; prices are per adult in economy. For a named route on a date or a
month use `search_flights` or `get_prices_calendar`.

There is deliberately no date argument: this endpoint ignores one (verified —
passing a December date returns the same July and September fares), and each
result carries its own `departure_at`.

destination.description: Destination IATA code. Optional — omit to search anywhere.

currency.description: Price currency (3 letters). Defaults to the server's currency.

market.description:
2-letter market whose price cache to read. Defaults to the
server's configured market.

tools.name: lookup_airlines
tools.description:
Look up airlines by name or IATA code.

Use when the user asks which airline a code belongs to, or wants the IATA
code for an airline name. For an airport, city, or country code use
`lookup_airports`, `lookup_cities`, or `lookup_countries`; for fares use
`search_flights`.

search.description:
Airline name substring or exact IATA code (e.g. "aeroflot", "SU").
Omit to list airlines from the start of the dataset.

locale.description:
2-letter locale for names (e.g. "en", "ru"). Defaults to the
server's locale.

tools.name: lookup_airports
tools.description:
Look up airports by name, IATA code, or city code.

Use when the user names an airport or a code and needs its city, country,
or coordinates. For the closest airport to a town that does not share the
airport's name, use `find_nearest_airports` instead of this tool.

The full dataset is ~10k airports, so always pass `search` — an unfiltered
call just returns the first `limit` entries in dataset order. Results are
ranked: exact code, then exact city code, then name matches, with airports
you cannot actually fly to last.

search.description:
Airport name substring, exact IATA code, or city code
(e.g. "heathrow", "LHR", "MOW").

locale.description:
2-letter locale for names (e.g. "en", "ru"). Defaults to the
server's locale.

tools.name: lookup_cities
tools.description:
Look up cities by name or IATA code and return the code flight tools expect.

Use when the user names a city and a flight search needs its IATA code.
For an airport code use `lookup_airports`; for the nearest airport to a
place that is not itself a city, use `find_nearest_airports`.

Every flight tool takes IATA codes, so this is usually the first call when
the user names a place. The full dataset is ~9.6k cities, so always pass
`search`. Names are only available in the requested locale: searching
"Мюнхен" needs locale="ru".

search.description: City name substring or exact IATA code (e.g. "bangkok", "BKK").

locale.description:
2-letter locale for names (e.g. "en", "ru"). Defaults to the
server's locale.

tools.name: lookup_countries
tools.description:
Look up countries by name or two-letter country code.

Use when the user asks which country a code belongs to, or wants that
country's code or currency. For a city or airport code use `lookup_cities`
or `lookup_airports`; this tool does not search flight prices.

search.description: Country name substring or exact code (e.g. "thailand", "TH").

locale.description:
2-letter locale for names (e.g. "en", "ru"). Defaults to the
server's locale.

tools.name: find_nearest_airports
tools.description:
Find the airports closest to a place name or to a latitude and longitude.

Use when the user asks which airport to fly into for a town, a resort, or
a point on the map. `lookup_airports` only matches a name, and the nearest
airport is rarely named after the town, so call this tool for that
question. Feed the returned city code, not the airport code, to
`search_flights` for fares.

Pass either `near` (resolved against the city and airport datasets) or an
explicit `latitude`/`longitude` pair.

near.description: Place name or IATA code to search around (e.g. "Pattaya", "UTP").

max_distance_km.description: Ignore airports further away than this. Optional.

flightable_only.description: Skip airports with no scheduled service (default True).

locale.description: 2-letter locale for names. Defaults to the server's locale.
